creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-03 on the devenv: a Claude Code pane at 432k tokens (43%) sat idle about 2h45m and Claude Code's own idle compaction never fired. Coming back to it meant a full uncached read of 432k tokens, or a compaction that pays that read anyway.

Claude Code's idle compaction is best-effort. Read from the 2.1.312 bundle: it arms a timer at 90% of the one-hour cache lifetime after a turn ends, then skips silently on several conditions (a near-limit rate-limit status, the timer firing more than 60 s late, a newer request, a UI refusal). The skip reason goes only to Anthropic's telemetry, nothing local. It does work on this machine ('Compacted while idle' in several transcripts on 2.1.302-2.1.312), but not for this pane, and nothing showed why.

Muster already knows each pane's state, how long it has been idle and its context %. a_2luwIdT57 would show when a cache is about to go cold; this would act on it.

Possibly: an opt-in rule that runs `muster pane compact` on an idle Claude Code pane before its cache expires, for example idle at least ~45 minutes and context at least a configurable threshold, with a default 'what to keep' text. Skip panes blocked at a dialog or waiting on declared work, and skip a pane whose harness already compacted (its context % dropped since the turn ended).
title: Compact an idle Claude Code pane before its prompt cache expires, when Claude Code's own idle compaction does not fire
